criterion: Secondary features revealed at the right time
description: Show invite text reveals the full setup prompt immediately. The warning "Visible on screen. Stop sharing your screen before copying." appears in the same frame as the text, so a person who is screen-sharing has already exposed it when they read the warning.
expected: A guard before reveal (e.g. "Reveal on screen?" confirmation or press-and-hold) with the warning shown first.
actual: Warning and text appear together; no confirmation.
suggested_fix: Show the warning with a "Reveal anyway" button before rendering the textarea.

description: After the text has been revealed nothing suggests that the safe recovery is to revoke it and create a new one.
expected: Once revealed, the status line offers "If others saw this, Revoke and create a new one."
actual: Only the screen-sharing warning; no recovery hint.
suggested_fix: Add the recovery sentence to the revealed state.
